title: Failure characterization for one query step
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $0<\tau\le1$, let $k<n$, and let a query state have no inaccurate estimate in its trace. After appending a finite list of estimate records and performing the query step at stage $k$, the resulting state has an inaccurate estimate in its trace if and only if at least one record in the appended list is inaccurate.
